title: Make study fetch firstmate at a resolved pinned SHA, readable by agents
summary: Study is already registered in the CLI wiring. The missing work is a core job-start hook that resolves firstmate's main to a SHA, records it, and places the pinned tree inside the agents' confined read-only working directory. [capabilities.study] must also be added to athena.toml. This retry fixes the earlier unreadable-source and missing hook-test findings.

defaults_applied.how: Dispatch-level hook test, a study fetch test using a local git repo, and a catalog test; fmt, clippy and test must pass.
The pin is verified by code (HEAD equals the resolved SHA) and the confinement is enforced by the path policy; neither is prose-only.
One change on the hook, the study fetch and the config section.
Use the git CLI for resolve and checkout instead of a new crate.
Doc comments and docs/decisions.md note the resolve-on-start choice.

assumptions: The hook is not in the tree: grep finds no on_job_start, so the earlier attempt never landed and all of it is redone.

The firstmate URL is https://github.com/kunchenguid/firstmate, configured in [capabilities.study]; no SHA is configured. Athena's code resolves the main branch to a full SHA at study start with git ls-remote, then checks out that SHA.
The resolved SHA is recorded in the job's brief note and in a record or artifact the job already writes, not in athena.toml.
The pinned tree is copied or exported into each agent's snapshot under a read-only subpath, and is excluded from the change list, so confine accepts reads of it.
Study cargo grants run offline via CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true in the study env.

acceptance_criteria.text: athena_core::capability::Capability has a default no-op job-start hook returning a brief note and extra env. Change keeps the default, and Study overrides it.
run.rs calls the hook at job start before the producer. The note appears in the producer and verifier briefs, and the env reaches both agents.
athena.toml gains [capabilities.study] (named in this criterion) with the firstmate URL, a branch of main, and offline cargo grants and env. It holds no hard-coded SHA.

Study resolves the configured branch to a full 40-hex SHA when a study starts, checks out that SHA, verifies HEAD equals it, and records it. A missing URL, failed resolution or mismatch gives a clear error.

The pinned tree sits inside each agent's confined working directory (producer and verifier snapshots), read-only, and is excluded from the change list and admission. The path named in the brief resolves inside the policy root.
Run cargo test. A dispatch-level test with a fake capability shows the hook ran, its note reached the brief and its env reached the agents. It fails if the run.rs call is removed.

Run cargo test. A study test builds a local git repo, resolves its branch to a SHA, and shows Read, Grep and Glob accept the materialized tree under the path policy and that it is absent from the change list.
Run cargo test. The reader catalog lists change and study, and the reader schema's capability enum includes study.
Run cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo test. All pass.

out_of_scope: Study run step, containment, replay and publishing.
departures: The scope spans core, the study crate, config and tests, and the earlier attempt failed on exactly this, so cost and risk sit above the reference.
